name: Morten Johansen
bio: Enterprise IT leader with 18 years of experience designing and operating complex systems across hybrid environments. I lead a global team, operate cloud infrastructure, and automate everything I can — Terraform, OpenTofu, Python, Go, PowerShell. Passionate about ITSM/ESM done right and making technology invisible so people can do their best work.

projects.name: echo
